text: I brought the map and found the quietest table. Would you like to choose the tea?

name: mai/chapter1/window
alt: A potted plant on a sunny windowsill
caption: The window seat has a tiny garden beside it.

then.text: Good choice. It smells like the first warm day of spring.
Then I'll choose the tea I always order.
Jasmine for you, then. I remembered.

text: The map's first stop is right here. The next scene is waiting in Places, where we can talk face to face.

name: mai/chapter1/postcard
alt: A hand-drawn map on a postcard
caption: I took a picture so we could follow the route.

steps.text: Mai's map has a date at the teahouse. You can find it in Places.

needs.hint: Play First date in Places, then come back here.

then.text: That was lovely. I have one more part of the map to show you.
